note: Files that draw with their own <svg>. 'engine' is the scene engine's player. 'notTeaching' are not teaching pictures and stay as they are: icons, the cat and the owl, writing and drawing surfaces, the English app's pictures, the old shopping game. 'toMove' is empty and stays empty: every maths teaching picture is worked out in packages/learning/src (scene.ts, figure-marks.ts, lesson-marks.ts) and drawn by the player. A new file may be added to none of these lists (see CLAUDE.md).
